# Eclipse Systems

> Custom business software for Birmingham and beyond: client portals, operations systems, CRM, storefronts, dashboards, workflow automation and integrations.

## Business solutions
- [Custom software](https://www.eclipsesystems.pro/features/custom-software): Discovery, prototyping and scoped implementation.
- [Client portals](https://www.eclipsesystems.pro/features/client-portals): Customer requests, documents and project information.
- [Birmingham business software](https://www.eclipsesystems.pro/locations/birmingham-al): Workflow planning for Birmingham and Central Alabama businesses.
- [Build or buy](https://www.eclipsesystems.pro/vs): Compare buying a product, connecting tools, customizing a foundation and a bespoke build.
- [Engagements](https://www.eclipsesystems.pro/pricing): Pricing is scoped after discovery for custom work.
- [Guides](https://www.eclipsesystems.pro/blog): Business workflow and software planning resources.
- [Contact](https://www.eclipsesystems.pro/contact): Discuss a project.

## Separate product: ClockEclipse
Employee timekeeping, scheduling, PTO and payroll review live at [ClockEclipse](https://clockeclipse.com/), not in the custom-software offer. Use that site's current features, plans and guides for employee timekeeping questions. Historical Eclipse Timekeeping package prices and comparisons on this domain are retired.
